pitch.title: Know if your AI agent change is safe to ship
pitch.body: Heimdall tests the old and new version of your agent on the same tasks and tells you which is better, before your users find out.

run.title: Test any agent on real tasks
run.body: Coding, browser, voice, tools and more, with tasks checked to be fair.

bifrost.title: Every model call goes through Bifrost
bifrost.body: One gateway that records cost, can inject failures and keeps a full log of each call.

sealed.title: Results you can trust
sealed.body: Every pass, fail and slowdown is backed by saved, tamper-proof records.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to test and review your agents.

banner.detail: Real results. You can look but not change anything.

quickstart.title: Get started
quickstart.subtitle: Four commands take you from your code to a clear answer: is the new agent better or worse?

steps.init: Looks at your project (tests, agents, Docker) and writes a .heimdall/ settings folder.
steps.mine: Turns past commits into tasks your agent must solve.
steps.compare: Runs the old and new agent side by side and says which is better.
steps.ci: Adds a GitHub check that comments on every pull request.

quickstart.minedSubtitle: Check the written instructions before you trust the results.
